Commentary.Commentary: So, after an awesome bowling performance from Pakistan, will we something similar from Afghanistan? Or will the Pakistanis run away with the game? Join us for the run chase to find out!

Coming to the Pakistan bowlers, they were right on top of their game! They did leak runs at the start but did not let the game get away from them. Once the first wicket fell, they tightened the screws and suffocated the Afghanistan batters. This made them take risks which resulted in wickets being thrown away. The spin trio of Qasim Akram, Aamir Ali and Fahad Munir bowled overs quickly while bowling supremely economical. Their fielding was poor as simple catches were missed but that did not come back to bite them.

The innings started in fantastic fashion for Afghanistan as they came out all guns blazing and rocked the Pakistan pacers early on. After the first 6 overs, they were 41/0 but after that, things really started to fall apart from them. The run-flow slowed down after that and wickets started to come at regular intervals. Rahmanullah Khan and Abid Mohammadi both tried to get a move on but failed as the pressure piled on. However, Abdul Rahman at the death added some handy runs giving the Afghans something to bowl at. Farhan Zakhir, the Afghanistan skipper, was the top scorer for them with 40 runs.

The Pakistan players are in a huddle out on the field before going back into the middle. Looks like they are getting a pep-talk from their captain and they will be looking to wrap up the job safely while batting. Afghanistan would be wounded but will be backing themselves in the bowling department and defend the below-par target they have given.
